title: As He Backs ICE Crackdown, Nebraska Governor Employs Undocumented Workers
summary: Gov. Jim Pillen’s family business is one of the nation’s largest pork producers. As he seeks re-election, he has aligned himself with President Trump’s anti-immigrant agenda even though his farms have taken on undocumented laborers.
